title: OhmPuter
summary: Electronics calc: SMD codes, colour bands, Ohm's law, dividers, LED, RC, battery
description:
OhmPuter is a keyboard-first electronics helper for the CardputerZero.

- MARK: read printed codes - SMD resistors (103, 4992, 4R7, EIA-96 01C), capacitors (104, 4n7, 104K, 2A104J with voltage and tolerance), tantalum (A106), inductors (101, 4R7) and common diode / transistor codes (M7, T4, 1AM...). Every plausible reading is listed; resistors also show their colour code
- BANDS: type the colours as digits (4 7 2 G) to get value, tolerance and tempco for 3-6 band resistors, or a value to get its 4- and 5-band code
- TOOLS: Ohm's law, voltage divider with the best E-series resistor pair, LED series resistor with power rating, RC time constant / cut-off, LC resonance, battery runtime
- E6/E12/E24/E48/E96 preferred values, SI input (4k7, 2u2, 10m)

Tab switches MARK / BANDS / TOOLS, F1 shows help.
